gate had no cell to bind and instantiated the target FRESH, under a comment
reading "so the proof never binds the hole's live frontier" — a sentence that
presents as a safeguard and describes the defect, because against a fresh copy
the candidate is never checked against the hole at all. Context carries the
handle now (its fourth field was the hole's SPAN, a coordinate copied beside
the handle that gives it live); type and span are reads of it; candidate_proven
unifies the candidate's cell with the hole's inside the segment the trail
already brackets. unify already existed. One edge where three copies were.

Reason would have had zero readers. The candidate's own Reason rides the unify.

ground shape — a weaker second copy of the union-find — and was unsound in the

mentl/da59303:
In mixed-shape match dispatch, $ec5_emit_match_arms_filtered_from
correctly skips arms whose shape doesn't match the cascade's
want_shape — but only at the FIRST mismatched arm. Once it delegates
to $ec5_emit_match_arms_from (which assumes uniform shape), the LPCon
recursion at line 442-444 calls $ec5_emit_match_arms_from again,
bypassing the filter for every subsequent arm.

Concrete failure (probe `match t { TA(n) => ..., TB => ..., TC(n) =>
... }`): both cascades emitted ALL arms — TC's `$n + 300` body
appeared in the sentinel cascade with `$n` unbound (sentinel arms
have no field structure to descend into); TB's nullary body appeared
in the fielded cascade with `(i32.load offset=0) (i32.const 1)
(i32.eq)` tag dispatch (TB has no heap tag — it's sentinel value 1).

Fix: filter check at the top of the LPCon case in
$ec5_emit_match_arms_from. If sub_pats.len > 0 (fielded) and $shape
== 0 (nullary cascade), or sub_pats.len == 0 (nullary) and $shape ==
1 (fielded cascade), recurse on idx+1 and return. Pure-shape matches
pass through cleanly because classify_arms_shape only assigns a
single shape when all LPCon arms match it.

Verification: probe `match t { TA(n) => n + 100, TB => 200, TC(n) =>
n + 300 }` now emits:
  sentinel cascade: e == 1 → 200; else unreachable
  fielded cascade: tag == 0 → n + 100; else tag == 2 → n + 300; else unreachable

tokensafe/dae6ca2:
Phase 5 of the monetization roadmap. Agents register callback URLs +
mint lists via Bearer-auth CRUD endpoints. Background job polls watched
mints on a configurable interval (default 5min) and delivers HMAC-SHA256
signed POST payloads when risk thresholds are exceeded.

Architecture: SQLite via better-sqlite3 (zero-config, works with Railway
persistent volume) over Redis ($8+/mo add-on). Synchronous API keeps the
CRUD layer simple. Delivery retries with exponential backoff (1m, 5m,
then abandoned after 3 attempts).

New routes (before x402 gate, Bearer-auth protected):
  POST /v1/webhooks — register subscription
  GET /v1/webhooks — list (secret redacted)
  PATCH /v1/webhooks/:id — update
  DELETE /v1/webhooks/:id — delete

New files: db.ts (schema + CRUD), webhook-delivery.ts (HMAC + retry),
monitor-job.ts (background polling via checkTokenLite).
perennials/da55a97:
Every invariant in here was checked once by hand against the live 8,800
and then the script was thrown away. That is exactly how "a lone
hardiness number is a floor, not a one-zone window" stayed wrong long
enough to drop Red mulberry and hardy kiwi out of a zone-6 search:
nothing was watching.

Fifteen tests over the pure rules, no DOM and no mocking. What a
hardiness record means and what it refuses to claim; that a plant nobody
measured never sorts below one the record rules out; that every month
lands on exactly one of USDA's nine season words and never straddles
two; that an unrecorded period covers no slots, which is not the same
sentence as "does not flower"; that a wandering thumb cannot grow a
stroke past its cap.

They earn their place: put the fabricated max back and exactly the
three that should fail, fail. vitest because Node's own resolver cannot
follow the source's extensionless imports, and it is what a Vite project
already implies; devDependency only, never shipped.
